speaker: customer
text: Fifteen thousand a year is just too much.

speaker: agent
text: Fair — it is real money. Can I ask what feels heavy: the amount itself, or paying for something you might never use?

speaker: customer
text: The second one, honestly. I am healthy.

speaker: agent
text: Then here is the number that changed my mind: one night in a city ICU is about forty thousand. This is one-third of one night, per year, for unlimited nights.

speaker: customer
text: Hm. When you put it that way...

speaker: agent
text: And if you never claim, your cover grows every year as a bonus. Healthy is exactly when this is cheap.
